title: A Two-Parameter Weibull Framework for Diagnosing Transformer Weight Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2605.18898v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformer checkpoints contain billions of weights, yet how their element-wise distributions vary across components, models, and training is hard to characterize. We fit the magnitude distribution of each analyzed weight matrix with a two-parameter Weibull reference model under a fixed middle-80% protocol. For i.i.d. Gaussian initialization, the corresponding half-Normal target has protocol-fitted shape $k_0 \approx 1.20$. Matched comparisons with gamma and lognormal favor Weibull for most component groups; support is less decisive for separately stored MHA query/key projections, and no tested single family cleanly describes matrices carrying a secondary weight population.   Across 12 model entries spanning seven families, terminal FFN shape medians fall in a narrow band, $k \in [1.186, 1.204]$ (CV $= 0.51\%$), whereas query/key projections show architecture-associated departures. This stability is macroscopic only: in the five Pyth

translated_title: 用于诊断Transformer权重分布的双参数Weibull框架
translated_abstract: Transformer检查点包含数十亿个权重，但其逐元素分布如何随组件、模型和训练而变化仍难以刻画。我们在固定的中间80%协议下，用双参数Weibull参考模型拟合每个受分析权重矩阵的幅值分布。对于独立同分布的高斯初始化，对应的半正态目标经协议拟合得到的形状参数为 $k_0 \approx 1.20$。与gamma分布和对数正态分布的匹配比较表明，Weibull分布对大多数组件组更为适用；对于单独存储的MHA查询/键投影，支持度则不够明确，且没有哪个被测试的单一分布族能干净地描述带有次级权重群体的矩阵。在跨越七个系列的12个模型条目中，终端FFN形状参数中位数落在很窄的区间内，$k \in [1.186, 1.204]$（变异系数 CV = 0.51%），而查询/键投影则表现出与架构相关的偏离。这种稳定性仅在宏观层面成立：在五个Pyth（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用双参数Weibull分布作为统一参考框架来诊断Transformer权重幅值分布，发现跨七个模型系列的FFN权重形状参数高度稳定（约1.20），而查询/键投影则呈现与架构相关的系统性偏离。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-parameter Weibull reference framework for diagnosing Transformer weight magnitude distributions, revealing remarkably stable FFN shape parameters (~1.20) across seven model families, while query/key projections exhibit architecture-dependent departures.
